data.name: Thippesh
data.gender_notes: Thippesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is the master of the mountain or the ruler of the earth. A name for a strong and courageous boy. The name Thippesh carries the meaning “Lord of the Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Tamil. Parents who choose Thippesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Thippesh is a divine name that signifies power, strength, and the ability to overcome challenges. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is believed to bring blessings of courage, vitality, and success in life.
data.etymology: Thippesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Thippesh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Thippesh" evokes an image of strength, courage, and power, as it invokes the idea of a ruler or master of a mountain or the earth. In Hindu mythology, mountains and the earth are personified and have a deep cultural significance, often representing the stable foundation upon which the universe is built. A person named Thippesh is seen as a strong, powerful, and courageous individual who commands respect and admiration within their community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Thippesh" can be seen as a reminder of the inner strength and courage that we all possess within ourselves. It can be a source of inspiration for individuals to tap into their inner power to overcome challenges and obstacles in their lives. Additionally, it can be a reminder of the connection between the earth and the divine, and the importance of honoring the natural world and the inner workings of the universe. In this way, the name Thippesh can serve as a powerful reminder of the interconnectedness of all things and the importance of living with integrity, strength, and courage.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Thippesh: The name Thippesh signifies the radiant 'Thippa' (cup) of divine nectar (Amrit) that bestows the blessings of wisdom and prosperity. It represents the purifying and enlightening power of divine knowledge and the inner thirst for true wisdom.
